content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Marietta

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your background—secondary degree holders and bachelor's degree holders have different thresholds. Gather documentation of your project experience to verify you meet the baseline before applying.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend all sessions from your location—no commute required—and interact in real time with active certified practitioners. This formal education satisfies PMI's mandatory contact-hour requirement and deepens your knowledge of project-management frameworks.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, create your PMI account and submit your official application. Include your education, experience, and course completion verification. Pay the PMI exam fee and allow time for application review before your eligibility window opens.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor feedback—to reinforce core competencies and test-taking strategies. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. On exam day, demonstrate your mastery of project-management knowledge and earn your PMP credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: Renew your PMP every three years by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, conferences, volunteering, or on-the-job application. Stay current with PMI continuing-education standards and keep your credential active as you advance your career in Marietta's growing project-management roles.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
